system.summary: Numeric nomenclator 3-368: letters with homophones, syllables, words and names; 355 and 365-368 used as nulls. Same code 1691-1694, for the King and for Pontchartrain.

prior_solution.where: Inventory FRAN_IR_003977 marks the five pieces 'non déchiffré'; catalogue 539 vetting (2 Nov 2026) found no edition or decipherment; the period decipherments of ff. 376 and 452 (same volume) were used as key source only.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout ordered and paid the reproduction (Archives nationales) and set the protocol; AI agents transcribed (blind passes and arbiter), built the key, measured and read.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Glossed letters ff. 376 and 452 transcribed with their interlinear decipherment; the five undeciphered pieces transcribed in two blind passes plus a blind arbiter.
Key from f. 376 by EM alignment of number runs with the gloss, hand-curated (KEY_v1, frozen); pre-registered held-out test on f. 452: 0.830 vs best of 200 controls 0.102, below the 0.85 bar (fail).
Five pieces decoded with KEY_v2 (v1 + omitted f. 376 values + f. 452 gloss values); context-only values counted as holes.

Integration of PR #876 (AI agent, for the maintainers; not a person): reading.md, f. 152 sentence 4, printed "elle a" and counted 12 words; the "a" is group 355 at 0154 R4 (transcription.txt), a null in key.tsv and shown as a null in decryption.txt. The word is taken out: sentence 4 has 11 words and 2 holes, f. 152 134 of 150, the five pieces 239 of 271 (0.882, as before to three places). The question whether the reproduction may be analysed with an AI assistant is taken out of the gaps: it is a condition of use (NOTES.md), not an unread piece of the text. No image opened.

validation.notes: Pre-registered held-out test on f. 452: character agreement 0.830, best of 200 permuted-key controls 0.102; criterion >= 0.85 and >= control + 0.30 -> not met (absolute bar). Portion burnt; key not validated at the standard bar.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.fraction_read_source: rule of #728: 239 sure words of 271 cipher words (reading.md); probables, restorations and context-only values are holes. 240 of 272 until 24 Nov 2026: sentence 4 of f. 152 counted "a" on group 355 (0154 R4), a null in key.tsv.

credits.note: Reproduction ordered from the Archives nationales; key from the volume's period decipherments; five undeciphered pieces read in part

gaps.detail: 4 groups lost in the binding (0233 L, 0243 L, 0439 L)
no fresh glossed portion to validate KEY_v2: the 16 further glossed pieces of AE/B/I/381 (f. 131, 222, 261, 289, 317, 325, 330, 339, 398, 400, 409, 422, 425, 448, 470, 472) are not ordered

texts.label: f. 152, 9 Apr 1691 (copy sent with the King's reply of 8 Jun 1691)

reading_review.by: integration review of PR #876 (AI agent, for the maintainers); not a person
reading_review.note: Decryption reproduced by the round-5 review from key.tsv and the arbitrated transcription (48 of 48 lines, all five pieces). Read here as sentences in reading.md, with the clear words it quotes, and in translation.md: twelve passages on ending French protection of the Venetians at the Porte and keeping the Venice trade for ships with French passports. The French builds sentences; unresolved groups are marked (305, 280, 177, 57, 146, 152, 61, 33, 59). Grade B: raw, the passages hold together only through the quoted clear text. Sentence 4 still prints 'elle a' and counts 12 words: that 'a' is group 355 (0154 R4), a null in key.tsv since ed395f62da, and the file's own rule says nulls give no word, so the figures by that rule are 134 of 150 for f. 152 and 239 of 271 in all (filed 135 of 151 and 240 of 272; corrected in reading.md, NOTES.md and this profile later on 24 Nov 2026, after the 355 of 0154 R4 was confirmed as a null in key.tsv, transcription.txt and decryption.txt). Key not validated at the pre-registered bar (0.830 < 0.85). Not checked: the images, tools/em.py, that the keys were frozen before the measure.

texts.label: f. 155, 27 Jun 1691 (King's reply to the letter of 19 Apr 1691; copy)

reading_review.by: integration review of PR #876 (AI agent, for the maintainers); not a person
reading_review.note: Decryption reproduced by the round-5 review from key.tsv and the arbitrated transcription. Read here in reading.md and translation.md: one French sentence of the King's reply (Châteauneuf must not give up, by any consent, what the capitulations stipulate), complete in sense with four marked holes (qu'il and ont from context, a stray f in 'désister', group 196). Grade B: raw. The printed sentence has 31 words by my count and by the review's (filed 26 of 30, not changed here). Key not validated at the pre-registered bar (0.830 < 0.85). Not checked: the images.

reading_review.by: integration review of PR #876 (AI agent, for the maintainers); not a person
reading_review.note: Decryption reproduced by the round-5 review from key.tsv and the arbitrated transcription. Read here in reading.md and translation.md: three cipher passages that complete clear sentences (keeping the Venetians out of the Grand Seigneur's ports under foreign protection; that the consent should not appear; the siege of La Canée). French sentences with four marked holes, two of them gutter losses. Grade B: raw, the sense depends on the quoted clear text. Group 355 at 0232 S1 is a null and gives no word here. Key not validated at the pre-registered bar (0.830 < 0.85). Not checked: the images.
